name: flow
description: Shows what Claude is doing: a progress bar and numbered task checklist above the prompt, and a pane with the subagents at work and the files they touch. Uses a few tokens: Claude posts its steps through a small tool (none with "Ask Claude for its steps" off).

enabled.title: Flow
enabled.description: Track turns, tasks, subagents and files, and draw the progress band.

band.title: Band
band.description: What the band above the prompt shows while Claude works: full lists the tasks, compact keeps to one row, off draws nothing.

maxTasks.title: Tasks shown
maxTasks.description: How many task rows the full band lists at once.

steps.title: Ask Claude for its steps
steps.description: Give Claude a small tool to post its plan as steps, so the band has a progress bar even when it keeps no task list. Adds one tool and one sentence to the system prompt.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane for subagents
autoOpen.description: Open the Flow pane by itself when a subagent starts (on a wide terminal).
